query.question: As of 2026-04-10, what were Tencent Holdings Limited FY2025 full-year revenues, profit attributable to equity holders, and the derived profit margin? Distinguish IFRS from non-IFRS figures.

executive_summary: As of 2026-04-10, Tencent Holdings Limited FY2025 full-year revenues were RMB751,766 million (IFRS). IFRS profit attributable to equity holders was RMB224.8 billion (approx RMB224,800 million as rounded text disclosure). Non-IFRS profit attributable was RMB259,626 million (precise table). Derived IFRS profit margin ≈29.9029%, non-IFRS profit margin ≈34.5355%.

claims.text: Tencent Holdings Limited FY2025 full-year revenues were RMB751,766 million (IFRS basis).
Tencent Holdings Limited FY2025 non-IFRS profit attributable to equity holders was RMB259,626 million.
Tencent Holdings Limited FY2025 IFRS profit attributable to equity holders was RMB224.8 billion.
Tencent Holdings Limited FY2025 derived IFRS profit margin equals (RMB224.8 billion converted to RMB224,800 million) divided by revenue RMB751,766 million = 29.9073%.
Tencent Holdings Limited FY2025 derived non-IFRS profit margin equals RMB259,626 million divided by revenue RMB751,766 million = 34.5584%.
